# pai mcp

Install the PAI tools for Claude Code

```
pai mcp <command>
```

Install the PAI tools for Claude Code.

```sh
pai mcp status
pai mcp install
```

### pai mcp install

Register the PAI MCP server with Claude Code

```
pai mcp install
```

Register the PAI MCP server with Claude Code.

Register the PAI MCP server (pai) in ~/.claude.json (restart Claude Code to activate)

```sh
pai mcp install
pai mcp status
```

See also: `pai mcp status`

### pai mcp status

Show whether the PAI MCP server is registered

```
pai mcp status
```

Show whether the PAI MCP server is registered.

Show whether the PAI MCP server (pai) is registered and the binary exists

```sh
pai mcp status
pai mcp status
```

See also: `pai mcp install`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `pai mcp install` | Register the PAI MCP server with Claude Code |
| `pai mcp status` | Show whether the PAI MCP server is registered |
